The conversation covered several technical topics. Initially, [me] asked for advice on the correct Ubuntu version (18, 20, or 22) to use in WSL, and [p1] recommended 22.04 as a modern LTS option.

Regarding deployment, [me] requested that analytics be deployed from `develop` to staging. [p1] confirmed they could deploy it to production as well. They discussed the process of merging and deploying from master, which [me] later clarified was not necessary for Angular 12 -> develop at this time.

Later, [me] suggested upgrading Chart.js to version 3 along with a major version upgrade (13 or 14). Finally, [p1] confirmed that the analytics deployment had been completed on both staging and production.
decisions: Analytics was deployed from develop to staging
Analytics was also deployed to production
